description: A scoped human decision on one exact phase revision. Simulators, models, scores and labels cannot produce one.

authorized_role.description: Role that holds the decision right (a role, not a person's name).
authorized_role.title: Authorized Role

decision_id.description: Opaque decision id, referenced by governance events.
decision_id.title: Decision Id

entry_check_ref.description: Published entry-criteria version of the successor phase, or of integration acceptance, that this revision was evaluated against: the 'governs' link.
entry_check_ref.title: Entry Check Ref

evidence_refs.description: Reading ids the decision relied on. Required for accept.
evidence_refs.title: Evidence Refs

expires_at.description: Timezone-aware expiry, after decided_at; None = no expiry.
expires_at.title: Expires At

outcome.description: accept closes the revision; hold keeps it; return sends it back for rework.
outcome.title: Outcome

recorded_by.description: Only a human records a decision. No other value exists.
recorded_by.title: Recorded By

scope.description: What the decision covers and what it does not.
scope.title: Scope

title: AcceptanceDecision
